label: SuperCollider scsynth audio server
summary: Optional local synthesis and sample laboratory for deterministic or performed audio experiments that remain portable outside the live server.

handoffs.label: Develop a bounded scsynth study
handoffs.intent: Test one player-facing synthesis or sample relationship with SuperCollider without turning the live server into the EPRS source of truth.
inputs: A musical hypothesis, seed/timing policy, and source-bound sample paths when used
A song-relative .scd source and a new lossless output destination
outputs: A new WAV audition plus tool/version and render evidence
steps: Keep the musical idea in player language, then declare tempo, duration, seed, sample-rate, and any live input or local OSC boundary.
Use sclang/scsynth or the IDE for the smallest useful study; keep audio-server control local and explicit.
Copy or render the result into a new EPRS experiment artifact, inspect it, and record a keep/change/stop decision.
verification: Confirm the .scd source, SuperCollider version, render settings, and source checksums are preserved.
Confirm the WAV is non-silent, not clipped, and retains the declared sample rate.
Treat the server performance as an audition until the EPRS render, provenance, and listening gates are complete.

handoffs.label: Run a local scsynth server
handoffs.intent: Use SuperCollider's real-time server for an explicitly operated local session while keeping network and session state outside portable release contracts.
inputs: A named local audio device and bounded session duration
A declared reason that real-time server behavior is useful for this experiment
outputs: A local performance capture or session note
A portable source/render handoff for later EPRS review
steps: Bind the server to localhost and use only the intended audio device; do not expose remote OSC by default.
Record the session locally if it contains a keeper, preserving timing, device, server, and source details.
Rebuild any release candidate through the ordinary EPRS master, picture, and review path.
verification: Confirm no unrequested remote control surface was enabled.
Confirm the captured audio is a new artifact and the editable source remains available.
Record whether the result is a live document, experiment, or release candidate.

preserve: Portable .scd source, local samples, server/version settings, captures, and review notes
EPRS's renderer-neutral source and release contracts
avoid: Making SuperCollider required, embedding the only arrangement in a live session, or enabling remote OSC without explicit operator setup
Treating GPL-3 software as if it changed the rights of separately authored audio or samples
